name: auth-failure
description: Mosyle refuses the JWT login, so /login answers 401. A permanently refused credential, as opposed to the one-off 401 that auth-refresh covers. The run must END THE TASK IN ERROR: reporting zero assets and exiting 0 is what an empty tenant does, so without the error an operator sees a green task and an estate that appears to have emptied itself. The refusal is not retried either -- 401 is outside the transient retry set -- which is what the pinned request count carries. No /listdevices request may be made without a bearer token.
